goals.description: Peptides for hair loss next to finasteride and minoxidil: FDA status, evidence in people and price per month for each option, checked and dated.
goals.short_answer: Finasteride and minoxidil are the only treatments on this page the FDA has approved for hair loss, and generic finasteride starts at about $10 a month. Copper peptide serums are cosmetics: the evidence is from lab and follicle-culture studies, not from large trials in people. Injectable peptides sold for hair are not approved for any use, and we found no human evidence for hair.
